nodes.name: ApiPaths
nodes.summary: Every path prefix, named once for the controllers and the security rules alike.

endpoints.summary: Creates the account unconfirmed and emails a code; the session comes with the code.
Confirms the email with the code from the letter and opens the first session.
Sends a new confirmation letter, at most once per cooldown.
Opens a session by email or username and password; an unconfirmed email gets a code instead.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and the next refresh token.
Revokes the session the refresh token belongs to; open, since the access token may have expired.
The signed-in user.
Whether a username is still free, for the sign-up form's live hint.
Every tag on the signed-in user's cards, for suggestions in the editor.
One card.
Changes the fields that are set; a topicId moves the card to that topic.
Deletes a card.
Copies a card into the same topic with its tags and images and no practice progress.
Uploads a picture before the card is saved (multipart: file); the card then lists its id.
A picture's bytes; open without a token so an img tag can load it.
The signed-in user's saved picks; all fields null before the first save.
Saves the whole set of picks.
Topics other people shared with the signed-in user, flat, each with its owner.
Opens a public link or an invitation link and answers the first topic it opened.
Marks the share a topic came through as opened.
Leaves the share a topic came through, with every topic below it.
Copies a topic the user can see, with its subtopics, cards and pictures, into their own topics.

nodes.name: SharingController
nodes.summary: The sharing of the tree the topic {id} belongs to; every call answers it as it stands after.

endpoints.summary: Who can see the topic's tree: people, waiting invitations, the public link.
Invites someone by email or username to topics of the tree and emails them a link.
Revokes an invitation not accepted yet; its link stops working.
Replaces the topics of the tree a person may see.
Takes the whole tree from a person; the public link no longer lets them back in.
Turns the tree's public link on or off and sets the topics it opens.
Gives the public link a new token; the old link stops working, people keep their access.
Takes the tree from everyone who came through the public link alone.
The signed-in user's topics, flat, with the number of cards directly in each.
Creates a topic at the end of its parent's children (parentId null: a root).
Renames a topic.
Moves a topic under a new parent at a given place; a topic cannot go inside itself.
Deletes a topic with its subtopics and all their cards.
The cards directly in a topic, newest first.
Creates a card in the topic from its question, answer, tags and already uploaded images.

nodes.name: AppMailProperties
nodes.summary: Our own mail settings; the SMTP server itself is Spring Boot's `spring.mail.*`.

nodes.name: AsyncConfig
nodes.summary: `@Async` work (sending letters) runs on Spring Boot's task executor, so a slow SMTP server never holds up an HTTP response.

nodes.name: CardProperties
nodes.summary: Limits on a card's content that are a product decision rather than a column size.

nodes.name: ContentConfig
nodes.summary: Topics, cards and their pictures: their settings, and the scheduled removal of unused uploads.

nodes.name: EmailTemplateProperties
nodes.summary: Where the letter templates are and what they are called.

nodes.name: ImageProperties
nodes.summary: Card pictures: where the files are kept, what is accepted, when unused uploads go.

nodes.name: ImageS3Properties
nodes.summary: The S3 bucket card pictures go to when prep-deck.images.storage=S3.

nodes.name: ImageStorageConfig
nodes.summary: The S3 client, made only when pictures are kept in a bucket (prep-deck.images.storage=S3).

nodes.name: JwtConfig
nodes.summary: The key access tokens are signed and checked with (HS256), and the encoder and decoder built on it.

nodes.name: JwtProperties
nodes.summary: Access tokens are short-lived JWTs; refresh tokens are opaque and live in the database.

nodes.name: MailConfig
nodes.summary: Our mail settings: the sender, the support address, where the letter templates are.

nodes.name: MapStructConfig
nodes.summary: Shared settings for every mapper: each one is a Spring bean, receives its collaborators through the constructor, and has its generated implementation in an impl package beside it.

nodes.name: SecurityConfig
nodes.summary: Stateless JWT security: no session, no CSRF token (nothing rides on a cookie), every request outside the open auth endpoints needs a valid Bearer access token.

nodes.name: SharingConfig
nodes.summary: Sharing topics: its settings.

nodes.name: SharingProperties
nodes.summary: Sharing topics with other people: what links look like, how invitations behave.

nodes.name: VerificationProperties
nodes.summary: How one-time email codes behave.

nodes.name: AccentColor
nodes.summary: The eight interface accents.

nodes.name: CardStatus
nodes.summary: Where a card stands for the caller, worked out from their practice.

nodes.name: ImageStorageType
nodes.summary: Where uploaded card pictures are kept.

nodes.name: ImageType
nodes.summary: The picture formats a card accepts, recognised by their first bytes rather than the file name.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.summary: The languages the app speaks: the interface language a user picks and the language letters are written in.

nodes.name: ThemeMode
nodes.summary: Dark or light interface.

nodes.name: TopicAction
nodes.summary: What a caller wants to do with a topic and the cards in it; TopicRole#allows decides.

nodes.name: TopicRole
nodes.summary: The caller's role on a topic, and the one list of what each role may do.

nodes.name: LoginRequest
nodes.summary: Log in with an email or a username.

nodes.name: RefreshRequest
nodes.summary: Body of refresh and log out: the refresh token the client holds.

nodes.name: RegisterRequest
nodes.summary: Sign-up.

nodes.name: ResendCodeRequest
nodes.summary: Asks for a new confirmation letter.

nodes.name: VerifyEmailRequest
nodes.summary: The code from the confirmation letter, for the email it was sent to.

nodes.name: CodeAttemptsResponse
nodes.summary: The data of an "auth.codeInvalid" refusal: wrong guesses still allowed for this code.

nodes.name: RegistrationResponse
nodes.summary: Sign-up accepted: the account waits for its email to be confirmed, and a letter with the code is on its way to email.

nodes.name: SessionResponse
nodes.summary: What log in, sign up and refresh answer with (client type `Session`).

nodes.name: UnconfirmedEmailResponse
nodes.summary: The data of an "auth.emailNotVerified" refusal at log in: the right password, an email not yet confirmed.

nodes.name: UserResponse
nodes.summary: The user as the client sees them (client type `User`).

nodes.name: CreateCardRequest
nodes.summary: A new card.

nodes.name: DuplicateCardRequest
nodes.summary: The copy's question, already in the user's language ("… (copy)", "… (копія)"); null keeps the original's question as it is.

nodes.name: UpdateCardRequest
nodes.summary: Changes to a card; a field left null stays as it is.

nodes.name: CardResponse
nodes.summary: A card as the client shows it (client type `Card`).

nodes.name: ApiResponse
nodes.summary: The one shape every endpoint answers with, success or failure alike.

nodes.name: RetryAfterResponse
nodes.summary: The data of a "too soon" refusal ("auth.resendTooSoon", "share.inviteTooSoon"): seconds until the same letter may be asked for again.

nodes.name: ImageResponse
nodes.summary: An uploaded picture (client type `CardImage`); url is absolute and opens without a token.

nodes.name: MinImageSizeResponse
nodes.summary: The data of an "images.tooSmall" refusal: the smallest size accepted, in pixels.

nodes.name: UpdateSettingsRequest
nodes.summary: Every pick at once: the client always sends the whole set it shows.

nodes.name: SettingsResponse
nodes.summary: A user's saved picks (client type `Settings`).

nodes.name: AcceptShareRequest
nodes.summary: A public link or an invitation link, as pasted or opened: the token alone or the whole link (everything after its last "/" is taken).

nodes.name: CopyTopicRequest
nodes.summary: Where the copy goes among the caller's own topics; parentId null makes it a root.

nodes.name: InviteRequest
nodes.summary: Invites someone by email or username to the topics given, all of one tree.

nodes.name: ShareTopicsRequest
nodes.summary: The whole new set of topics a person may see in one tree; it replaces the old set.

nodes.name: UpdateLinkRequest
nodes.summary: Turns the tree's public link on or off.

nodes.name: ShareInviteResponse
nodes.summary: An invitation letter not accepted yet.

nodes.name: ShareLinkResponse
nodes.summary: The tree's public link.

nodes.name: ShareMemberResponse
nodes.summary: A person with access to part of a tree: the topics granted to them (each with its subtree), in tree order.

nodes.name: SharingResponse
nodes.summary: Who can see a tree and how (client type `TopicSharing`): the people with access, the invitations still waiting, and the public link.

nodes.name: CreateTopicRequest
nodes.summary: A new topic at the end of its parent's children; parentId null makes a root.

nodes.name: MoveTopicRequest
nodes.summary: A new place: under parentId (null: the top level), at order among the new siblings counted without the topic itself.

nodes.name: TopicResponse
nodes.summary: One topic of the flat list the client builds its tree from (client type `Topic`).

nodes.name: ApiException
nodes.summary: A refusal the client should show: an HTTP status and a message key ("auth.emailTaken") that the client translates into the user's language, plus, when the client needs more to act on it, a small data…

nodes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
nodes.summary: Turns every failure into an ApiResponse, so a client never has to parse a second error format.

nodes.name: OrphanImageCleanupJob
nodes.summary: Removes pictures that were uploaded for a card that was never saved, or taken off every card, once they are older than prep-deck.images.orphan-ttl.

nodes.name: EmailService
nodes.summary: Renders a template and hands the letter to the SMTP server configured in `spring.mail.*`.

nodes.name: EmailTemplates
nodes.summary: The letter templates (location and names in EmailTemplateProperties), filled in by name: every {{key}} becomes its value, HTML-escaped.

nodes.name: InvitedTopic
nodes.summary: One topic of an invitation letter: its title, the titles above it (path, empty for a root), the cards in its whole subtree, and whether it has subtopics that come along.

nodes.name: Letter
nodes.summary: A rendered letter: the subject line and the HTML body.

nodes.name: ShareInviteIssued
nodes.summary: An invitation was saved and its letter should go out.

nodes.name: ShareInviteMailListener
nodes.summary: Sends the invitation letter once the invitation is safely in the database, on a thread of its own.

nodes.name: VerificationCodeIssued
nodes.summary: A code was saved and its letter should go out.

nodes.name: VerificationMailListener
nodes.summary: Sends the confirmation letter once the code is safely in the database, on a thread of its own.

nodes.name: Card
nodes.summary: A question with a Markdown answer, its tags and up to five pictures, in one topic.

nodes.name: CardMapper
nodes.summary: Practice is not built yet: every card is new for everyone and never due.

nodes.name: TopicCardCount
nodes.summary: How many cards sit directly in one topic.

nodes.name: CodePurpose
nodes.summary: What a one-time code unlocks.

nodes.name: OneTimeCode
nodes.summary: A six-digit code sent by email, kept as a hash, good for a few guesses and a few minutes.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: An uploaded picture; its bytes are an object named by the id in the image store.

nodes.name: ImageUrls
nodes.summary: Where a picture can be fetched: an absolute URL on the host the request came to, so an can load it straight away.

nodes.name: DiskImageFileStoreImpl
nodes.summary: Files in prep-deck.images.directory, made on start if missing.

nodes.name: ImageFileStore
nodes.summary: The bytes of uploaded pictures, one object per image id; their rows live in the database.

nodes.name: S3ImageFileStoreImpl
nodes.summary: Objects in an S3 bucket (prep-deck.images.s3.*), keyed .

nodes.name: S3ObjectInputStream
nodes.summary: The body of a GetObject response that gives its connection back properly however it ends.

nodes.name: S3ObjectResource
nodes.summary: An S3 object served as a response body.

nodes.name: UserSettings
nodes.summary: A user's picks, the same on every device: look, language, the topic opened last.

nodes.name: GrantSource
nodes.summary: How a grant came about.

nodes.name: ShareBlock
nodes.summary: An owner took access from this user: the owner's public links no longer let them in.

nodes.name: ShareBlockKey
nodes.summary: The key of ShareBlock: one row per owner and user.

nodes.name: ShareInvite
nodes.summary: A personal invitation sent by email.

nodes.name: ShareLink
nodes.summary: The public link of one tree.

nodes.name: TopicGrant
nodes.summary: Someone other than the owner may see a topic and its whole subtree.

nodes.name: RefreshToken
nodes.summary: One issued refresh token, by its SHA-256 only.

nodes.name: Topic
nodes.summary: A folder of cards in its owner's tree.

nodes.name: TopicMapper
nodes.summary: Practice is not built yet, so nothing is due.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: An account.

nodes.name: JsonSecurityErrors
nodes.summary: 401 and 403 from the security filters, in the same ApiResponse shape as everything else.

nodes.name: JwtService
nodes.summary: Signs access tokens.

nodes.name: OneTimeCodes
nodes.summary: Six-digit codes for letters.

nodes.name: OpaqueTokens
nodes.summary: Refresh tokens: 256 random bits for the client, their SHA-256 for the database.

nodes.name: AuthWebService
nodes.summary: Sign-up with email confirmation, log in, refresh, log out.

nodes.name: AuthWebServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Each method is one transaction: rotation reads a locked row, revokes it and inserts its successor, and those must succeed or fail together.

nodes.name: CardWebService
nodes.summary: Cards in a user's topics.

nodes.name: CardWebServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Reads run in a transaction too: a card's tags and pictures load lazily while it is mapped.

nodes.name: ImageContent
nodes.summary: A picture's bytes ready to stream, with what the response headers need.

nodes.name: ImageSize
nodes.summary: A picture's size in pixels as it is displayed, EXIF rotation applied.

nodes.name: ImageSizeReader
nodes.summary: Reads a picture's width and height from its own headers (metadata-extractor), never decoding the pixels, so the size the client claims is never needed or trusted.

nodes.name: ImageWebService
nodes.summary: Card pictures.

nodes.name: SettingsWebService
nodes.summary: A user's picks kept on the server, so every device they sign in on starts the same: theme, accent, language, the topic opened last.

nodes.name: CardCopy
nodes.summary: A card read for copying: its content, and its pictures by the ids of the originals.

nodes.name: SharedEntry
nodes.summary: One topic of Shared with me before its card count is known: parentId is null where the part the user sees starts, and path names the parents above it they cannot see.

nodes.name: SharedTopicWebService
nodes.summary: The side of the people a topic is shared with: Shared with me, coming in, leaving.

nodes.name: SharedTree
nodes.summary: One owner's tree that is being shared: its root and all the owner's topics around it.

nodes.name: SharingWebService
nodes.summary: The owner's side of sharing: who can see a tree, and the ways in.

nodes.name: SharingWebServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Each method is one transaction: replacing a person's grants, or revoking an old invitation and saving its successor, must land together.

nodes.name: TopicCopyPlan
nodes.summary: What a copy will be made of, read in one transaction: the topics of the subtree (parents first), their cards oldest first, and every picture they show.

nodes.name: TopicCopyWebService
nodes.summary: "Copy to my topics": a topic someone can see becomes theirs to change.

nodes.name: TopicCopyWebServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Three steps, as an upload does: the subtree is read in one short transaction; the picture files are copied inside the store with no transaction open, so a slow bucket never holds a database connectio…

nodes.name: TopicAccess
nodes.summary: A topic the caller was let through to, and the role that let them.

nodes.name: TopicForest
nodes.summary: One owner's topics as trees in memory, built from the flat list the database gives.

nodes.name: TopicGuard
nodes.summary: The one place that decides whether a user may touch a topic and the cards in it.

nodes.name: TopicWebService
nodes.summary: A user's topic tree: read flat, grown, renamed, rearranged and pruned.

nodes.name: TopicWebServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Every change goes through TopicGuard with TopicAction#EDIT, and works on the owner's tree (the topic's owner, not necessarily the caller), so a role that may edit someone else's topics later needs no…
